patches.summary: Serialize each promoted command's bound flags into the POST request body (and omit unset flags).
patches.reason: The generated promoted_*.go template built `body := map[string]any{}` and called c.Post(path, body) without ever copying the bound flag variables in, so every parameterized command (get-text, set-text, copy-pad, ...) sent an empty {} body and the API rejected it with 'padID is not a string' etc. No-arg endpoints were unaffected.
patches.validated_outcome: go test ./internal/cli (TestPromotedSerializesFlagsIntoBody / TestPromotedOmitsEmptyFlags) plus a binary smoke test confirm e.g. set-text now sends {"padID":...,"text":...,"authorId":...}; per-endpoint API casing (authorId vs authorID) is taken from spec.json.
patches.upstream_issue: https://github.com/mvanhorn/cli-printing-press (promoted-command template must populate the request body from registered flags)
